import django
django.setup()

from django.test import RequestFactory
from django.contrib.auth.models import User

Bash(DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE=config.settings python3 -c "
import django
django.setup()
from grades.models import Grade
from competitions.models import Discipline

print('Vérification des grades par discipline:')
disciplines = Discipline.objects.filter(is_active=True)
for d in disciplines:
    count = Grade.objects.filter(discipline=d, is_active=True).count()
    print(f'  - {d.name} (ID: {d.id}): {count} grades')

print('\nTest de quelques grades:')
karate_grades = Grade.objects.filter(discipline__name='Karaté', is_active=True)[:3]
for g in karate_grades:
    print(f'  - {g.name} (ID: {g.id}, Level: {g.level}, Color: {g.color})')
")
